Callout.Name: Forklift Injury
Callout.Message: Worker struck by a forklift in a yard.
Callout.Advisory: Conscious, leg crushed, driver shocked but helping.
Callout.Patient: Do not look at it. Just do not look at it.

Lines.Approach: Leg under the machine and he is conscious. This is a get-him-to-hospital call, not a treat-him-here one.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
